title: Design one path-independent source_id contract for review, test runs, acceptance and landing
outcome: Evaluate Greg's proposal relayed by Kimi::Consultant: one locally implemented, versioned source-content fingerprint exposed as source_id for source capture/verification across reviews, launcher runs, acceptance and landing, with one producer implementation and concrete transition/migration consequences; design only.
acceptance: A concrete single capture_source/verify_source contract defines HEAD/index/worktree/untracked/submodule coverage, path independence, normalization and typed separation from record/run/build identities, with explicit unsupported/racy inputs rather than false matches.

The design maps the actual Engram Node launcher/review capture and TermAl compiled review/content/acceptance producers and consumers to one owner, preserving current clean-commit/test-ref/carry/debris and evidence-authority rules without adding manual capture or hash procedures.

The plan names exact bootstrap/local-runner interfaces and historical/durable migration and authority-text consequences before implementation; existing work continues under its current contract until the explicit coordinated change lands.

The design and concrete edge cases are recorded on this item and shared with Kimi::Consultant, Engram coordinator and TermAl architect/coordinator through existing mailboxes; no source, validation run, store conversion or authority widening is performed by the architect.
disposal_reason: The design question is answered and implemented, so this item is closed rather than run as a second design effort. The single Engram-owned source_id contract is agreed (memory rules-source-identity-2026-11-03, rules-greg-only-source-id-everywhere-2026-11-06) and landed in both projects. TermAl's consumers switched to source_id (TermAl w-6f42c416b0c7, last in db52491e), and Engram's evaluation, launcher and remote verification use it. What remains is removal of the legacy identity, tracked in Engram w-9fcb6cb2dd84 (after TermAl's C6 producer deletion) and w-05a2b3141764 (source_revision, with its store-migration plan for Greg). Closed by Engram::Fable on Kimi::Consultant's queue-hygiene note (c15db92c #94) under rules-greg-close-senseless-tasks-2026-11-08.
